goals.description: Stir the simmering soup
goals.segment_summary: Recipe step S01: Heat butter in a pot over medium heat until the butter melts. Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir in carrots and mix until properly coated. Add water and broth; bring to a lively simmer over high heat.  Reduce heat to maintain a lively simmer and cook until very tender, about 25 minutes.
